assets.title: 낯선 말 찻집
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 16:9 landscape game concept screenshot for Korean game design article. Primary request: ONE coherent actual-looking 2D pixel-art gameplay screen of STRANGE WORDS, a grammar-deciphering game in a tiny tea room. Scene: small original gray dog host and unusual original fantasy rabbit-like visitor greeting at a tiny tea table. Main gameplay panel dominates the center: three distinctly pictographic tokens of a cup, a rabbit, and a cat placed in ordered slots. Beneath it two interpretation strips use simple icons, the first cat giving a cup to rabbit (arrow right), the second rabbit giving a cup to cat (arrow left); highlight one editable hypothesis with a small pointer. Below, physical toy animal figurines and a cup demonstrate a counterexample. The mechanic is experimenting with word order and meaning. Compact bottom buttons read TRY, COMPARE, NOTE. Small top title STRANGE WORDS. Warm paper panel, teal and lilac cozy pixel-art environment. Clearly deliberate chunky pixels, clean legible shapes, game camera, richly authored but uncluttered. No poster, no collage, no combat, no timed orders, no realism, no text paragraphs. Illustrative UI, not numerical instructions. 16:9 wide canvas.
assets.edit_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached STRANGE WORDS game screenshot only to fix its central LOWER pink hypothesis strip. Keep all composition, character art, top token row, room, palette, table figurines, buttons and lettering exactly as they are. The upper green strip is already correct and MUST remain: BLACK CAT at left, CUP near center, RIGHT-POINTING ARROW, WHITE RABBIT at right. In the LOWER PINK STRIP, swap ONLY the two animal portraits so the BLACK CAT is now at LEFT and the WHITE RABBIT is at RIGHT. Preserve the lower strip's LEFT-POINTING ARROW pointing toward the cat on the left. The cup stays between the cat and arrow. The upper and lower strips must have IDENTICAL cat-left/rabbit-right portrait positions but OPPOSITE arrow directions: top CAT → RABBIT, lower CAT ← RABBIT. Very clear arrows, top cup travels cat to rabbit, lower cup travels rabbit to cat. Do not simultaneously reverse animal portrait order and arrow. Minimal correction, same pixel-art style, same 16:9 image. No extra labels or altered text.
